summary.headline: Causes of Native Prosperity
summary.text: Chapter IX explains how the Part of Fortune’s conjunctions and applications to benefic or malefic planets signify prosperity or loss, then assigns sources of prosperity according to its placement in the exaltations of the Sun, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, Mercury, or Moon.
